synopsis_zh: 蓝调时刻，一名身着珍珠白与深石墨色装甲的成年女信使独立于未来都市上空的平台。她张开手掌，青色能量核心缓缓升起并展开纤薄几何光环，一道青色脉冲掠过城市，逐层唤醒沉寂的天际线。六秒连续镜头平稳后移，以清晰锐利的细节呈现克制而壮观的科幻瞬间。
image1_prompt: Sky Reboot, cinematic photorealistic sci-fi reference image, one standalone 16:9 composition, no collage. Waist-up portrait of a lone adult female courier standing on an elevated platform above a futuristic city at blue hour. She has a short straight black bob, a clearly adult face, natural skin texture, precise eyes, and a calm, focused expression. Sleek fitted armor combines satin pearl-white ceramic plates with dark graphite articulated sections, finely machined seams, subtle ceramic wear, brushed metal fasteners, and flexible black joint material. No helmet. Her right forearm extends comfortably in front of her torso, palm upward, fingers naturally curved beneath a luminous cyan energy sphere approximately ten centimeters across; her left arm rests at her side. The core has a crisp spherical boundary, delicate internal geometric filaments, and restrained cyan illumination on her fingers and armor. Eye-level three-quarter frontal camera, natural perspective, sharp face and hands, anatomically correct fingers and joints. Behind her, a graphite platform with angular waist-high parapets overlooks layered silver-gray towers, narrow skybridges, and a distinctive central spire with a rectangular crown opening. Sparse dormant cyan and amber windows under a cobalt sky with a faint peach horizon. Deep focus, crisp architectural edges, controlled highlights, no excessive bloom, fog, blur, text, logos, or watermarks.
image2_prompt: Sky Reboot, cinematic photorealistic sci-fi environment reference image, one standalone 16:9 composition, no collage. An empty elevated graphite platform overlooking the same futuristic city at blue hour, viewed toward the skyline from the same camera axis as the character portrait. No people, no energy sphere, no halo. The foreground platform has precise rectangular floor panels, fine anti-slip grooves, recessed seams, brushed titanium edge trims, and angular waist-high parapets along both sides, leaving a broad unobstructed central view. Beyond it stretches a spectacular but clearly readable city of layered silver-gray towers, narrow skybridges, stepped terraces, and orderly transit corridors. Preserve a distinctive central spire with a rectangular crown opening as the principal skyline landmark. The city is dormant: most facades remain dark, with sparse cyan navigation strips and isolated warm amber windows, leaving substantial unlit architecture available for a later activation wave. Cobalt evening sky, faint peach horizon, clean dry atmosphere. Realistic ceramic cladding, glass reflections, structural ribs, and sharply defined building edges. Wide composition with level horizon, coherent scale, deep focus from platform to skyline, controlled contrast, restrained emissive accents, no fog, haze, blur, excessive bloom, text, logos, or watermarks.
video_prompt: Create one continuous six-second cinematic shot for Sky Reboot. Use <Picture 1> for the adult female courier, her face, short black bob, pearl-white and graphite armor, and cyan core. Use <Picture 2> for the platform, skyline, architecture, and dormant blue-hour lighting. Start waist-up at a three-quarter frontal angle, with the skyline visible beside her. Perform a smooth, modest dolly backward throughout; keep a level horizon and consistent perspective, with no cuts. 0–2 seconds: she stands grounded, calmly holding the core above her right palm; her fingers gently open while her left arm remains relaxed. 2–4 seconds: the sphere rises twenty centimeters, maintaining its shape, then unfolds a thin horizontal geometric halo around itself. Her eyes follow it with minimal head movement. 4–6 seconds: the halo releases one broad cyan pulse that sweeps outward across the skyline, sequentially activating architectural light strips and windows. Keep the pulse translucent so buildings remain readable. Finish with the courier steady and the illuminated city revealed behind her. Preserve facial identity, stable anatomy, five natural fingers per hand, detailed armor surfaces, and sharp architectural edges. Restrained glow; no fog, blur, text, or watermarks. Native electronic sound effects: soft core hum, delicate ascending shimmer, then a clean resonant activation pulse. No dialogue or music.
